now.title: Now playing
now.shuffle: Shuffle: the base list plays in random order

errors.trackNotFound: The song is no longer in the queue.
errors.playerUnavailable: The YouTube player could not be loaded.
errors.apiKeyMissing: The YouTube Data API key is missing, so playlists cannot be imported.
errors.playlistFailed: The playlist could not be read. Check that it is public and the API key.
errors.playlistEmpty: The playlist has no available songs.
errors.localOnly: The folder can only be changed from the computer running the server.
errors.folderInvalid: The folder does not exist, is not an absolute path or cannot be read.
errors.autoplayBlocked: The browser blocked autoplay. Press play on the player.
errors.playlistInvalid: The name is not valid or there are too many playlists.
errors.messageInvalid: The text is not valid: 400 characters at most and only the variables that message already has.
errors.layoutInvalid: The widget layout is not valid, or there are too many.
errors.layoutNotFound: That widget layout no longer exists.
errors.assetInUse: A layout uses that file: remove it from them before deleting it.
errors.assetInvalid: The file is not a supported image or font (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, WOFF2, TTF or OTF).
errors.assetTooLarge: The file is too large: 2 MB for images and 1 MB for fonts.
errors.assetLimit: There are too many uploaded files (50) or they take too much space (50 MB).

notices.playlistImported: Playlist imported: {{added}} new out of {{total}} songs.

chat.noPermission: @{{user}}, only moderators, VIPs and subscribers can use that command.

sr.usage: @{{user}}, use !sr followed by a YouTube link or the song name.
sr.invalid: @{{user}}, that YouTube link is not valid.
sr.added: @{{user}}, "{{title}}" added: it is number #{{position}} in the list.
sr.searchDisabled: @{{user}}, search by title is not enabled; use a YouTube link.
sr.searchFailed: @{{user}}, the song could not be searched right now. Try a link.
sr.unavailable: @{{user}}, “{{title}}” exists but cannot be played here and I found no version in the local library.
sr.replaced: @{{user}}, “{{original}}” cannot be played here; the local version “{{title}}” plays instead.
sr.tooLong: @{{user}}, “{{title}}” is longer than {{minutes}} minutes, which is the maximum allowed.
sr.live: @{{user}}, “{{title}}” is a live stream and live streams are not accepted.

queue.empty: Nothing is playing and the queue is empty.
queue.onlyCurrent: Now playing: {{current}}. No more songs in the queue.

skip.nothing: There is no song to skip.

voteskip.nothing: There is no song to skip.
voteskip.already: @{{user}}, you already voted to skip this song.

wrongsong.none: @{{user}}, you have no request to remove.

volume.invalid: @{{user}}, the volume must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

local.usage: @{{user}}, use !local followed by the title, the artist or a word from the song description.
local.disabled: @{{user}}, the local library is not available right now.
local.notFound: @{{user}}, I found no local track for "{{query}}". If the title is short, also add the artist or the album.

chat.requestsDisabled: @{{user}}, requests are turned off for now.

limit.user_other: @{{user}}, you already have {{count}} active requests; wait for one to play.
limit.global_one: @{{user}}, there is already {{count}} active request in total. Try again later.
limit.global_other: @{{user}}, there are already {{count}} active requests in total. Try again later.

library.title: Local library

library.include: Include the library in the base list
library.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, artist, album, comment or description

status.error: The music folder could not be read.

settings.title: Settings
settings.chatOff: Requests are off: !sr and !local add nothing.
settings.limitsHelp: Counts songs requested from chat that are playing or waiting in the queue.
settings.localFallback: Replace videos that cannot be played with their local version
settings.maxDurationHelp: Videos requested from chat that run longer are rejected, and so are live streams. The YouTube key is needed. Local tracks are not affected.
settings.localFallbackHelp: If a YouTube link exists but cannot be played here, its title is looked up in the local library and that track plays instead; with no clear match, the request is rejected or skipped. The YouTube key is needed to warn before queueing.
settings.widgetHelp: Add this address in OBS as a browser source (for example, 600 × 160). The background is transparent and it updates by itself. It stays invisible until someone types !queue or !song, or the track changes (10 s); add ?idle=0.3 to keep it semi-transparent. With the panel closed the widget shows no progress: the player lives in this tab.
settings.widgetCopyFailed: Could not copy: select the address and copy it by hand.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.youtubeKeyOff: missing: !sr only accepts links and video length is not checked

widgetEditor.title: Widget
widgetEditor.intro: Design the OBS widget: move, resize and rotate elements, hide them or add more. Built-in layouts are not modified: editing one saves a copy.
widgetEditor.empty: Waiting for the layouts from the server…
widgetEditor.shortcuts: With the canvas focused: arrows to move (Shift: 10 px), Delete to remove, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to undo and redo, Ctrl+D to duplicate, and hold Alt while dragging to skip the guides. Shift while rotating snaps to 15 degrees.
widgetEditor.sampleTitleLong: A very, very long song title that does not fit on a single line of the OBS widget
widgetEditor.name: Name
widgetEditor.selectHint: Select an element on the canvas or in the layers to edit it.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.queueAll: Add the whole playlist to the queue
playlists.itemsEmpty: The playlist is empty. Save songs from the history.

messages.title: Messages
messages.intro: Rewrite what the bot says in chat. Variables go between double braces and are replaced when it replies. A disabled message keeps the bot silent. An empty text, or one equal to the original, goes back to the original.
